revenueModel.text: Customers, including distributors and OEMs, pay the company for standard and custom interconnect products, cable assemblies and integrated solutions it designs and manufactures.
revenueModel.evidence: Cable assemblies manufactured for the RF Connector division are primarily manufactured at our San Diego, California facilities using state-of-the-art automation equipment and are sold through distributors or directly to major OEM accounts.
